what: float64 exact Jacobian log-determinants of residual blocks x + s(x), s(x) = W_L tanh(W_n ... tanh(W_1 x + b_1) ...) + b_L with every weight rescaled to spectral norm 0.9 (identical rescaling for every method), at B points: forward = objective values; vg = objective and its gradient w.r.t. every weight and bias. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_logdet.projected_deep_logdet: det(I_D + W_L A W_1) = det(I_H + A C) (Sylvester), with A C carried as H_n columns through the hidden layers and one H_n x H_n LU per point instead of the D x D Jacobian and its LU. The cell with D < H is a control where the candidate forms the D x D Jacobian; full-input methods are run where B D^2 <= 2e9 and B D^3 <= 4e12
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 12) > 4 so the projection is active, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (the full D x D Jacobian as a product of matrices and its determinant, no projection; objective derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions by central differences in 50 digits): values and objective 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.projected_generic: the same Sylvester identity through jax.jvp: H_n JVPs of z_1 -> a_n along the columns of C = W_1 W_L per point, then slogdet(I + A C); isolates the closed-form recursion from the identity
tiers.full_input_recursion: the D x D Jacobian by the forward recursion seeded with the D columns of W_1, then slogdet(I_D + J): the strongest full-input exact program; B D^2 <= 2e9 and B D^3 <= 4e12
tiers.autodiff_jacobian: jax.jacfwd or jax.jacrev of s per point, vmapped, then slogdet(I_D + J); same limits

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
